entries.name: KAYAKI (EmQuartier)
entries.description: Third branch of the charcoal yakizakana specialist, opening with a six-course Toyosu-inspired seafood set.

entries.name: Kaiten Sushi Ginza Onodera
entries.description: First Thailand outpost of the Japanese premium conveyor-sushi brand at CentralWorld, plates from B40.

entries.name: Sra Bua by Num Weerawat
entries.description: Siam Kempinski's Sra Bua relaunches under Chef Num with a biodiversity-driven Thai tasting menu; soft launch from July 31.

entries.name: Cova Bangkok
entries.description: The 200-year-old Milanese pasticceria opens a Maison Boutique doing coffee, all-day dining, afternoon tea and aperitivo.

entries.name: Bella Napoli Yen Akat
entries.description: Bangkok's longest-running pizzeria opens a second home on Soi Yen Akat 3 after 25 years.

entries.name: Cante, Glint, Luso & SoolHaus (Canopy by Hilton Bangkok Sukhumvit)
entries.description: Four new F&B concepts launched with the hotel's August 1 opening, including a rooftop pool bar.

entries.name: Pinki's Deli (Earth Ekkamai)
entries.description: Recently opened sourdough sandwich deli, this week launching an eight-brand collaboration spread platter.

entries.name: Butler
entries.description: New wave diner from Y Work at Market Place Thonglor; dry-aged striploin alongside grilled cheese.

entries.name: ThaiCoon
entries.description: Real Thai, No Rules concept from Chef Buddy and Chef Wai of Rasik Local Kitchen, still in soft opening beside Pullman Hotel G.

entries.name: Jakawaan
entries.description: Food designer Nick Pitthayanot's set-menu traditional Thai project on Sukhumvit 55.

trend_note: Import-led week: three confirmed openings are foreign brands landing first or expanded Thai outposts (Ginza Onodera, Cova, Canopy's four concepts), while heritage Thai names (Sra Bua, Bella Napoli) reinvent or replicate rather than start fresh. Nothing notable surfaced outside Bangkok.
